outcome: Correlation between preconception serum testosterone concentration and complication rate and gestational age
cohort: 37 women with PCOS and 126 healthy women who gave birth at Sundsvall County Hospital, Sweden, from 2009 to 2014
finding: Women with PCOS had a higher risk of pregnancy complications, miscarriage, and caesarean section compared to healthy women.
mod_finding: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) were more likely to undergo cesarean section compared to healthy women.
birth_weight: Measured, but no specific values mentioned
